name: Suffocating Grip, Greater
source: Legacy of the First World pg. 29
body:
Suffocating Grip, Greater (Ex)
Source Legacy of the First World pg. 29
When the barbarian is using the suffocating grip rage power, the grappled creature cannot hold its breath and immediately begins suffocating. A barbarian must be at least 12th level and have the suffocating grip rage power to select this rage power.
